item.scp_unleashed.scp469_feather.toolti: A long, pale feather, softer than it looks.
item.scp_unleashed.scp469_feather.detail: Found where something many winged came apart.
The rest of it is never far away.
message.scp_unleashed.scp469.refuses: There is nothing in the wings for the controller to take hold of.
archive.scp_unleashed.notes.scp469.0: Loose white feathers keep turning up in the area, far too many for any bird.
archive.scp_unleashed.notes.scp469.1: Whatever sheds them is large, and it is already moving.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.scp469_angel_spaw: SCP-469, the Many-Winged Angel: a pale mass of a dozen or more feathered wings with no body, head or face to be found. Keter-class.
It hunts anyone it can see and remembers where it saw them last. Its wings close around whoever it catches.
It never spawns naturally. Its file comes from the Archive.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.scp469_feather.1: A long, pale feather shed by SCP-469.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.scp469_feather.2: They turn up wherever it has been. Where many lie together, it is never far away.
dossier.scp_unleashed.469.title: The Many-Winged Angel
dossier.scp_unleashed.469.caption: SCP-469 in Chamber 469-A, photographed from the observation gallery.
dossier.scp_unleashed.469.page.0.title: Special Containment Procedures:
dossier.scp_unleashed.469.page.0.text.0: SCP-469 is to be kept in Chamber 469-A, a smooth-walled concrete pit eight metres deep, observed from a gallery set high in its upper wall. %rAccess procedures withheld.%r
dossier.scp_unleashed.469.page.0.text.1: Nothing that could be stacked, leaned or piled is to be left inside the chamber. Shed feathers are swept out from the gallery once a week. No one is to enter the chamber while SCP-469 is present.
dossier.scp_unleashed.469.page.0.text.2: **If SCP-469 is reduced to feathers, the chamber and nearby corridors are to be sealed and watched. It will return.**
dossier.scp_unleashed.469.page.1.title: Description:
dossier.scp_unleashed.469.page.1.text.0: SCP-469 is a mass of twelve to sixteen large feathered wings, pale grey to white, joined at a root that has never been seen. No body, head or face is visible from any angle. Spread out, it is roughly four metres across and two and a half metres high.
dossier.scp_unleashed.469.page.1.text.1: SCP-469 moves by planting its lower wings against the ground and dragging the rest of the mass after them. Its upper wings are never still. It can fold itself narrow enough to pass through an ordinary doorway.
dossier.scp_unleashed.469.page.1.text.2: SCP-469 pursues any person it can see. It does not tire, and when it loses sight of someone it goes to where they were last seen. Persons it catches are enfolded in its wings. %rCasualty records withheld.%r
dossier.scp_unleashed.469.page.2.title: Addendum 469-1: Incident Logs
dossier.scp_unleashed.469.page.2.text.0: **Incident 469-07:** A junior researcher slipped from the observation gallery into Chamber 469-A. SCP-469 closed its wings around him within seconds. A colleague struck at the wings with a pole until they opened, and the researcher was pulled out with minor injuries.
dossier.scp_unleashed.469.page.2.text.1: **Incident 469-12:** Mobile Task Force operatives reduced SCP-469 to a drift of loose feathers. The feathers were bagged and burned. Some minutes later SCP-469 was seen in a corridor two floors above the containment wing. **No method of destroying SCP-469 is known.**
dossier.scp_unleashed.469.page.3.title: Addendum 469-2: Provenance
dossier.scp_unleashed.469.page.3.text: SCP-469 has no recovery site. Its file surfaced in the Archive, and soon afterwards loose white feathers began turning up near its reader. %rWitness statements withheld.%r
